title: India leads in IBM's Digital Sovereignty Index, but faces challenges in proving control over AI and data
description: India proudly topped IBM's Digital Sovereignty Index with an impressive score of 79, surpassing the global average of 74. However, numerous Indian organisations struggled to establish control over artificial intelligence and technological dependency, with 63 percent reporting sovereignty challenges, exceeding the global figure. Nevertheless, 45 percent proactively tested their digital sovereignty controls, outpacing their global counterparts. This study underscores the pressing issues surrounding digital sovereignty in India.
